audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the full Secret Woods camping and bear scenes and both Wizard’s Tower events. Every quoted line and embedded response was reviewed in context. Canonical Bear, Bear’s Knowledge, Junimo, Community Center, Wizard, Yoba-world magic, and Magic Ink terminology was applied while Emily, the Bear, and M. Rasmodius retained distinct voices. Event commands, actors, movements, timings, conditions, item and sound IDs, placeholders, branch delimiters, emotes, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
